features:
Feature name: having_IP_Address
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether the URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, often used by phishers to hide their identity.

Feature name: URL_Length
Type: categorical
Description: Measures the character length of the URL; phishers often use long URLs to hide the suspicious domain.

Feature name: Shortining_Service
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether a URL shortening service (like bit.ly) is used to redirect and hide the true malicious URL.

Feature name: having_At_Symbol
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether the URL contains an '@' symbol, which causes the browser to ignore everything preceding it.

Feature name: double_slash_redirecting
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether a double slash '//' appears after the initial protocol, a technique used for hidden redirection.

Feature name: Prefix_Suffix
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether the domain name includes a hyphen '-', a common technique to make a fake URL look like a legitimate one.

Feature name: having_Sub_Domain
Type: categorical
Description: Evaluates the number of subdomains in the URL; phishing sites often use multiple subdomains to appear legitimate.

Feature name: SSLfinal_State
Type: categorical
Description: Evaluates the HTTPS and SSL certificate's validity, issuer trustworthiness, and age.

Feature name: Domain_registeration_length
Type: categorical
Description: Measures how long the domain has been registered; phishing sites typically have very short registration lifespans.

Feature name: Favicon
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether the website's favicon image is loaded from a domain different from the main URL.

Feature name: port
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether non-standard network ports are open, which is often a sign of a compromised or malicious server.

Feature name: HTTPS_token
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates whether the string 'https' is deceptively included within the domain part of the URL.

Feature name: Request_URL
Type: categorical
Description: Measures the percentage of external objects (like images or videos) loaded from a different domain.

Feature name: URL_of_Anchor
Type: categorical
Description: Evaluates whether anchor tags link to different domains, do not link to any webpage, or link to the same webpage.

Feature name: Links_in_tags
Type: categorical
Description: Examines the percentage of links within metadata, script, and link HTML tags pointing to external domains.

Feature name: SFH
Type: categorical
Description: Server Form Handler; evaluates if webpage form actions are handled suspiciously (e.g., routed to 'about:blank' or a different domain).

Feature name: Submitting_to_email
Type: categorical
Description: Checks if the website forms submit data directly to an email address (mailto:) instead of a secure server.

Feature name: Abnormal_URL
Type: categorical
Description: Identifies if the host name is not included in the URL based on WHOIS database records.

Feature name: Redirect
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates if the website uses excessive or hidden redirection to route users away from their intended destination.

Feature name: on_mouseover
Type: categorical
Description: Checks if JavaScript is used to alter the status bar to hide the true link destination when a user hovers over it.

Feature name: RightClick
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates if right-clicking is disabled on the page, a tactic used to prevent users from viewing the page source code.

Feature name: popUpWidnow
Type: categorical
Description: Checks if the website generates pop-up windows, especially those containing text fields asking for personal information.

Feature name: Iframe
Type: categorical
Description: Indicates if invisible or borderless iframes are used to load external, potentially malicious content without the user noticing.

Feature name: age_of_domain
Type: categorical
Description: The age of the domain; older domains are usually more trustworthy, whereas phishing domains are recently registered.

Feature name: DNSRecord
Type: categorical
Description: Checks if the domain has a valid DNS record; phishing domains often lack these or are missing from WHOIS databases.

Feature name: web_traffic
Type: categorical
Description: Evaluates the website's popularity and traffic rank (e.g., Alexa rank); phishing sites usually have low or unrecognized traffic.

Feature name: Page_Rank
Type: categorical
Description: Evaluates the importance of the webpage based on its PageRank value; lower scores are highly suspicious.

Feature name: Google_Index
Type: categorical
Description: Checks whether the website is currently indexed by Google; phishing sites are often not indexed.

Feature name: Links_pointing_to_page
Type: categorical
Description: Evaluates how many external links point to the webpage; legitimate sites usually have many incoming links.

Feature name: Statistical_report
Type: categorical
Description: Checks if the website's IP or domain is currently present in recognized phishing statistical reports or blacklists.
public_payload.task: phishing website detection; target classes are ['-1', '1']
